option_declaration:
// ShaderLOD projected-footprint procedural LOD; default off.
//#define SHADERLOD_PROCEDURAL_FOOTPRINT
distance_units: Camera distance in Minecraft blocks; procedural differential in tangent block units per raster pixel; thresholds in cycles per raster pixel.
transition: Original through 32 blocks; smoothstep32..48 enables continuous octave weights; second-harmonic-aware 0.125..0.25 cycles/pixel fade; first octave remains full. Parallax footprint expansion2..4 fades back to full normals; expansion>=4 retains original normal.
fallback: Literal original for private off, non-water-wave program, absent/unsupported core, global off, invalid/singular parallax/quad footprint, nonfinite derivatives or singular persistence; shadow/caustics/DH entry unchanged. Full near original finite-difference normal retained; active full parallax clone qualifies pinned level-zero sampling without reducing quality.
activation: private option AND PROGRAM_GBUFFERS_WATER AND WATER_WAVES AND core version2 AND global enabled1; supports WATER_PARALLAX on/off
attribution: Photon v1.3b by Benjamin Stott (SixthSurge), retained original LICENSE and Belmu wave comment.
